what: A change touched two source files, but only one of them ever got a mutant. Mutation testing reported a clean result, and a fix's own regression tests passed, while the second changed file's logic was never exercised by any mutant at all — found only once a reviewer traced which file each mutant actually targeted.
rule: Every non-test source file a change touches needs at least one mutant of its own; a changed file with none is named as a gap, not silently passed over.
fix: Enforcement: mutant validation now warns of a changed source file with no covering mutant, at the same point a run's mutants are checked. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-s.test.mjs`.
